data.title: The AI market may be in a bubble, but not the technology itself: Nomura IWM
data.description: Julia Wang of Nomura International Wealth Management says it's important to differentiate between the AI market and AI technology bubble. She also discusses China's competitive edge in its AI ecosystem, particularly in the hardware space.
data.keywords: Neutral,China,KOSPI Index,Semiconductor device manufacturing,Artificial intelligence,business news
